D.t: Joyce Beatty leads by 60.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 190,449 votes; a one point swing is about 1,575 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +53.6 and D +67.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
